findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "query_project" appears informational but accepts parameters (script) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "edit_project" is 14288 chars, far longer than this server's median (700). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.detail: Description of "edit_project" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: edit_project · Private data: calculate_ramp, calculate_window_size, edit_project · Public sink: calculate_floor_area, calculate_window_size, calculate_fence, calculate_concrete · Destructive: calculate_stairs, calculate_roof_pitch, calculate_wallpaper, calculate_deck, calculate_fence, calculate_roofing, delete_project, edit_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: edit_project · Private data: calculate_ramp, calculate_window_size, edit_project · Public sink: calculate_floor_area, calculate_window_size, calculate_fence, calculate_concrete · Destructive: calculate_stairs, calculate_roof_pitch, calculate_wallpaper, calculate_deck, calculate_fence, calculate_roofing, delete_project, edit_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
